name: ua-helper
description: UA Helper - overlay assistant for Ukraine GTA 5 RP (Electron app + self-hosted backend)

scripts.dev: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run dev -w app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w app && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w app && npm run lint -w server
scripts.server:dev: npm run rebuild:node && npm run dev -w server
